rows.grounds: compound nāda+bindu+maya; accusative modifier of seat

items.question: Should the wise practitioner draw the nāda-bindu seat in the middle of the substance?
premises: The seat is made of nāda and bindu.
The wise one performs the drawing.
The drawing occurs in the substance middle.
items.inference: The verse instructs the wise practitioner to draw the nāda-bindu seat in the middle of the substance.
uncertainties: The exact substance and ritual context are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The wise one should draw the seat made of nāda and bindu in the middle of the substance.
